claims.claim: Infleqtion disclosed on September 24, 2026 that it demonstrated 30 entangled logical qubits on its Sqale quantum computer. This is new primary evidence that narrows the prior technical-milestone uncertainty; it does not by itself establish fault-tolerant customer utility, economic quantum advantage, or scalable commercial economics.

For Alpha risk treatment, the falsifier should move from whether the 30-logical-qubit milestone occurs to whether the demonstrated logical-qubit result is independently reproducible and converts into customer workloads with measurable economic or operational advantage versus classical substitutes.

risks.risk: A disclosed logical-qubit demonstration can satisfy a technical milestone without proving repeatable customer economics or superiority to classical alternatives.

contradictions.contradiction: The previously forward 30-logical-qubit milestone now has issuer-filed demonstration evidence, while the economic-utility and scalable-commercialization bridge remains unverified.
contradictions.disposition: narrows the technical contradiction; preserve economic-utility falsifier rather than treating the milestone as unresolved

unknowns.unknown: Independent reproducibility, workload-level performance, customer deployment economics and comparison with classical alternatives remain unverified in this source.
